para: TrialAndErrorQ2T is a , used as the split_how parameter in when splitting quadrilateral &elems; into triangles.
TrialAndErrorQ2T tentatively splits each quad along both of its diagonals. The criterion given to the method will decide which of the results to accept, if any.

When the &skel; is sufficiently refined so that all &elems; have the correct dominant pixel type, using can be more efficient than TrialAndErrorQ2T. TrialAndErrorQ2T works better if the neighboring elements are not sufficiently homogeneous or if the boundary does not extend past the target &elem;.
